# Webina runtime

Unmodified Webina 1.0.5 runtime, compiled upstream from AutoDock Vina 1.2.3.
Source: https://github.com/durrantlab/webina/tree/4230729e7dad197b4c77912dffe30c8bcdd492ba/src/Webina
`vina.js` is stored as `vina.1.0.5.js`, the upstream pthread worker's expected name.
Apache 2.0; see LICENSE.txt. Copyright Jacob D. Durrant (Webina) and the AutoDock Vina authors.
The site supplies its own preparation, worker controller and result export interface.
